PC-2: Claimant must include partner; both partners must have reached State Pension age (simplified). Hazel has no partner (F4, F15, F21 all say no). So partner condition not applicable.
PC-3: Savings up to £10,000 ignored; above that, every £500 or part thereof counts as £1 weekly income.
PC-4: Guarantee Credit tops up weekly income to £227.10 (single) or £346.60 (couple); eligible if assessed income below threshold.
PC-5: Weekly Guarantee Credit amount is the difference between the threshold and assessed weekly income.

Threshold for single: £227.10 (PC-4). Since assessed income £152.77 < £227.10, eligible. Weekly amount = difference = £227.10 - £152.77 = £74.33.

But need to check if any other income? Only weekly_income_total given. Might include state pension, etc. But we have the total. So eligible.

AA-1: Must have reached State Pension age. Yes, age 74 > 66.
AA-2: Must have a physical or mental disability or health condition severe enough to need help with personal care or supervision.
AA-3: Must have needed that help for at least 6 months.
AA-4: Must have been in Great Britain for at least 2 of the last 3 years.
AA-5: Cannot get AA if already receiving DLA, PIP, or ADP.
AA-6: Paid at £76.70/week (lower) or £114.60/week (higher); higher rate when help needed both day and night.
AA-7: Scheme covers England and Wales; people in Scotland apply for Pension Age Disability Payment.

CTR-1: CTR available to people on low income or claiming benefits, up to 100% reduction. Each council runs its own scheme; model covers pensioners in England and Wales.

CTR-3: Applicant must be liable to pay council tax on the home they live in.
CTR-4: People who get Guarantee Credit of Pension Credit get maximum reduction (100% of net council tax charge).
CTR-5: Otherwise, people with capital above £16,000 cannot get a reduction.
CTR-6: Otherwise, weekly reduction = weekly net council tax charge (annual net charge / 52) less 20% of any weekly income above applicable amount. Applicable amount is Pension Credit guarantee amount (£238 single, £363.25 couple). Income from savings follows PC rule (£1 a week for every £500 or part of £500 over £10,000). Household eligible if weekly reduction > 0.
